name: enciluz-browser-tests
description: Pruebas en Chrome: diseño móvil (360/390/768 px) y validez de bloques en el editor.

scripts.editor: node editor-blocks.mjs "$(cd ../.. && docker compose run --rm --no-deps -T cli wp post list --post_type=page --fields=post_name,ID --format=json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps({p["post_name"]:p["ID"] for p in json.load(sys.stdin)}))')"
